# Gemini Image Segmentation (LLM Index)

Primary project docs:
- README.md
- AGENTS.md
- CONTRIBUTING.md
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- docs/MANUSCRIPT_ALIGNMENT.md
- docs/METHODS_CHANGELOG.md
- docs/NOTEBOOKS.md

Primary code entrypoints:
- src/gemini_segmentation/cli.py
- src/gemini_segmentation/models.py
- src/gemini_segmentation/io.py
- src/gemini_segmentation/metrics.py
- src/gemini_segmentation/fairness.py
- src/gemini_segmentation/prompts.py

Core config files:
- configs/prompts.yaml
- configs/paper.yaml
- configs/figure1_best_cases.yaml
- .codex/config.toml

Main commands:
- python -m gemini_segmentation.cli segment <dataset_name> <dataset_root> [flags]
- python -m gemini_segmentation.cli fairness <dataset_name> <dataset_root> <run_dir> [flags]
- python -m gemini_segmentation.paper.make_all --results <path/to/results.csv_or.parquet>
- python -m gemini_segmentation.paper.best_cases --config configs/figure1_best_cases.yaml
- python -m gemini_segmentation.paper.figures --fairness-dir <results/.../fairness>

Primary test targets:
- pytest -q
- pytest -q tests/test_cli.py tests/test_prompts.py
- pytest -q tests/test_replicate_segmenter.py
- pytest -q tests/test_paper.py tests/test_paper_figures.py tests/test_paper_best_cases.py
